items.name: theme
items.title: vizcn theme tokens
items.description: Structural --vz-* tokens (light + dark). Namespaced: installing vizcn never repaints your app.

items.name: palette
items.title: vizcn series palette
items.description: Brand-neutral categorical/ordinal series colors (seriesColor, RAMP, HEAT).

items.name: motion
items.title: vizcn motion (optional)
items.description: Pure-CSS entrance/interaction kit (vc-* classes). Forms render fine without it.

items.name: bench-matrix
items.title: Bench Matrix
items.description: Vendor-announcement style benchmark board: benchmark rows grouped by domain vs model columns, with a tinted hero column and bold best-in-row plates.

items.name: bubble-field
items.title: Bubble Field
items.description: Bubble scatter on log-log axes — position for two counts, bubble area for a third, color for category.

items.name: distribution-bar
items.title: Distribution Bar
items.description: Proportional stacked strip with in-segment labels and a share legend below.

items.name: dune-flow
items.title: Dune Flow
items.description: Smooth B-spline stacked area flow showing what a stream was made of and when the waves came.

items.name: frontier-board
items.title: Frontier Board
items.description: Interactive score-vs-cost scatter where each model's effort levels connect into an efficiency frontier line, with metric/version toggles, model filter, and hover focus.

items.name: pipeline-flow
items.title: Pipeline Flow
items.description: Horizontal chain of stage boxes linked by animated marching-ants arrows.

items.name: race-lines
items.title: Race Lines
items.description: Multi-series activity line chart with crosshair, sorted tooltip, and draw-in animation.

items.name: radar-profile
items.title: Radar Profile
items.description: Two-entity radar (spider) chart — overlapping strength polygons over shared 0-100 axes with a legend.

items.name: rank-bars
items.title: Rank Bars
items.description: Horizontal ranking bars — label, zero-based bar, value — with an accent-highlighted hero row.

items.name: stacked-activity
items.title: Stacked Activity Bars
items.description: Interactive stacked daily columns with a live legend that doubles as the tooltip; the last, incomplete day is hatched.

items.name: tug-of-war
items.title: Tug of War
items.description: Diverging duel bars: two contenders split a 100% rope per row; the brighter side is the winner.

items.name: waffle-grid
items.title: Waffle Grid
items.description: A 10x10 waffle grid rendering "N of 100" as countable filled cells with a bold readout and caption.

items.name: warming-stripes
items.title: Warming Stripes
items.description: Climate-stripes ribbon: one stripe per year, colored by era heat level on a sequential ramp.
